notes.text:
Soundtrack to the 1994 video game Streets Of Rage 3. 180g vinyl. Includes an OBI and a lithographic print with artwork from Sega's archives on one side and liner notes by Yuzo Koshiro on the other. Preorders from Data Discs also came with three postcards with box artwork from the 3 Streets Of Rage games.

Audio captured from a Japanese Model I Mega Drive with VA 1 motherboard (A2, A3, A4, A5, B1, B2 B3, B6, C6, C7, D3, D4) and a Japanese Mega Drive with digital output mod designed and built by "MtChocolate" (A1, A6, B4, B5, B7, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, D1, D2, D5, D6, D7).

All source material captured in 24bit/96kHz and mastered for vinyl by Shaun Crook, February-May 2017.
